title: 晶粒對晶圓混合接合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入已知良品、局部對位與混合介面。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore known-good die, local overlay and hybrid interfaces, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 晶粒輸入

stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for die inputs, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 已知良品置信度｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Known-good-die confidence | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對已知良品置信度，把「測試覆蓋率與逃逸率決定選片可信度，通過並非零缺陷。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For known-good-die confidence, turn "Test coverage and escapes determine selection confidence; passing is not defect-free." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「已知良品置信度」的模型：測試覆蓋率與逃逸率決定選片可信度，通過並非零缺陷。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較前測、接合後測與失效定位。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for known-good-die confidence: Test coverage and escapes determine selection confidence; passing is not defect-free. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare pre-bond, post-bond and localization data. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較前測、接合後測與失效定位。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare pre-bond, post-bond and localization data. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：把前測通過當成永久良品。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating a pretest pass as permanently good. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付已知良品置信度的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for known-good-die confidence, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.objective: 針對誤差分解，把「拾取、相機、平台與熱漂移的誤差須分解系統項和隨機項。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For overlay decomposition, turn "Separate systematic and random pickup, camera, stage and thermal errors." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：作重複放置和時間序列控制圖。 將「所有誤差都可用 RSS 相加」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Use repeat placements and time-series control charts. Challenge the hypothesis "Combining all errors by RSS regardless of correlation" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 作重複放置和時間序列控制圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Use repeat placements and time-series control charts. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有誤差都可用 RSS 相加。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Combining all errors by RSS regardless of correlation. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付誤差分解的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for overlay decomposition: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 誤差分解：機制
knowledge.text: 拾取、相機、平台與熱漂移的誤差須分解系統項和隨機項。
knowledge.textEn: Separate systematic and random pickup, camera, stage and thermal errors.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 作重複放置和時間序列控制圖。 必須排除的錯判：所有誤差都可用 RSS 相加。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Use repeat placements and time-series control charts. Misinterpretation to reject: Combining all errors by RSS regardless of correlation. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「誤差分解」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For overlay decomposition — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 所有誤差都可用 RSS 相加
晶粒良率乘積必精確等於組裝良率
作重複放置和時間序列控制圖。
optionsEn: Combining all errors by RSS regardless of correlation
Equating the die-yield product with exact assembly yield
Use repeat placements and time-series control charts.
quiz.explanation: 拾取、相機、平台與熱漂移的誤差須分解系統項和隨機項。 作重複放置和時間序列控制圖。 因此不能採用「所有誤差都可用 RSS 相加」。

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for bond-wave contact: Propagating contact is obstructed by warp and particles; cleanliness and mechanics interact. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare void shapes with contact initiation points. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.title: 介電質界面｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Dielectric interface | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對介電質界面，把「介電質接合提供支撐，銅電性合格仍可能存在未接合區。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For dielectric interface, turn "Dielectric bonding supports the stack; passing Cu conductivity may coexist with unbonded regions." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「介電質界面」的模型：介電質接合提供支撐，銅電性合格仍可能存在未接合區。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「對照聲學、裂紋與電性採樣。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。 原創算例：假設 20 顆晶粒各自良率 0.99 且獨立，全數良好機率 0.99²⁰≈0.818。若每顆選片後為 0.999，則≈0.980；這只算晶粒，不含接合相關缺陷。 請重算一次，將一項輸入改變 10%，並指出此近似與本單元證據的關係。

Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare acoustic, crack and electrical sampling. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement. Original example: For 20 independent dies at 0.99 yield, all-good probability is 0.99²⁰≈0.818; at 0.999 after selection it is≈0.980. Bonding and correlated defects are excluded. Recalculate, vary one input by 10%, and relate the approximation to this unit’s evidence.

steps.observationEn: Compare acoustic, crack and electrical sampling. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：銅接通就證明全部介電質接合。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

knowledge.textEn: Independent yield multiplication is a starting model; particles and warp introduce correlation.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 比較獨立預測與晶圓群聚失效。 必須排除的錯判：晶粒良率乘積必精確等於組裝良率。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare independent predictions with clustered wafer failures. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating the die-yield product with exact assembly yield. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「堆疊良率模型」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For stack-yield model — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 比較獨立預測與晶圓群聚失效。
晶粒良率乘積必精確等於組裝良率
平均高度合格即排除局部未接觸
optionsEn: Compare independent predictions with clustered wafer failures.
Equating the die-yield product with exact assembly yield
Using mean height to rule out local noncontact
quiz.explanation: 獨立乘法模型是起點，共因顆粒或翹曲會使缺陷相關。 比較獨立預測與晶圓群聚失效。 因此不能採用「晶粒良率乘積必精確等於組裝良率」。
quiz.explanationEn: Independent yield multiplication is a starting model; particles and warp introduce correlation. Compare independent predictions with clustered wafer failures. Therefore reject: Equating the die-yield product with exact assembly yield.

steps.title: 熱與資料交接｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Thermal and data handoff | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對熱與資料交接，把「後續熱循環可改變應力和電阻，需保留逐顆幾何及材料履歷。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For thermal and data handoff, turn "Later thermal cycles alter stress and resistance; retain per-die geometry and material history." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「熱與資料交接」的模型：後續熱循環可改變應力和電阻，需保留逐顆幾何及材料履歷。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「提交前後測配對資料及未驗證熱範圍。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for thermal and data handoff: Later thermal cycles alter stress and resistance; retain per-die geometry and material history. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Submit paired tests and unverified thermal ranges. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 提交前後測配對資料及未驗證熱範圍。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Submit paired tests and unverified thermal ranges. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：初始良率即可代表產品壽命。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating initial yield as product lifetime. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付熱與資料交接的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for thermal and data handoff, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.title: 熱與資料交接｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal and data handoff | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對熱與資料交接，把「後續熱循環可改變應力和電阻，需保留逐顆幾何及材料履歷。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For thermal and data handoff, turn "Later thermal cycles alter stress and resistance; retain per-die geometry and material history." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：提交前後測配對資料及未驗證熱範圍。 將「初始良率即可代表產品壽命」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Submit paired tests and unverified thermal ranges. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating initial yield as product lifetime" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 提交前後測配對資料及未驗證熱範圍。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Submit paired tests and unverified thermal ranges. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：初始良率即可代表產品壽命。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating initial yield as product lifetime. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付熱與資料交接的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for thermal and data handoff: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.
